text:
sasha: Heads-up — we need a targeted backfill for agg_user_sessions. S3 lag last 36h dropped ~1.2M events; aggregates look off for the dashboard. Can we run a recompute for 2026-03-17..2026-03-19?
liam: ack. do we know which partition keys are affected?
rachel: looks like region=eu and prod traffic only. I dug into the logs, the ingest lag was due to a transient exporter outage, events actually arrived but landed in delayed shard.
sasha: right — so we should avoid a full cluster recompute. proposing a scoped backfill: only shards [s-12..s-18], time window 2026-03-17T00:00 -> 2026-03-19T23:59, with conservative concurrency.
michael: sounds good. quota-wise: backend quota for replays is 400 slot-hrs/day. scoped run estimated ~36 slot-hrs if we set concurrency=6 and preserve rate-limit.
tara: can we use the priority-lane so dashboards keep serving with fallback to last-good? We should also surface progress in console (per-route progress %).
liam: we can. replay-bot run will create a job and attach a console-progress webhook. use priority=medium so it doesn't preempt canary lanes.
replay-bot: [bot] created backfill job job_id=bf-20260319-9c4; status=queued; shards=7; est_duration=3h 20m.
sasha: nice. run command I used locally:
```sh
rd-replay run \  
  --job-name bf-agg-user-sessions-20260317-19 \  
  --agg agg_user_sessions \  
  --shards s-12..s-18 \  
  --from 2026-03-17T00:00Z \  
  --to 2026-03-19T23:59Z \  
  --concurrency 6 \  
  --priority medium
```
liam: put a dedupe window in the job so we don't double-count late replays (idempotency 48h). also enable dry-run on one shard first.
rachel: agreed. i'll kick off dry-run on s-12 now and watch metrics. please don't run full until dry-run green.
michael: also add cost-tagging so finance can auto-allocate. tag=telemetry-replay/q1-emergency.
tara: UX note: can we expose a quick 'run-scoped-backfill' button in Rollouts UI next sprint? Product and infra keep asking for it — wants one-click from an aggregate page.
sasha: noted. for this incident, manual is fine. rachel, ping when dry-run finishes and we'll promote.
rachel: dry-run complete: s-12 passes (counts reconcile). no duplicate deltas. kicking s-13 next. :thumbsup:
sasha: thanks — will wait for 2/7 shards green before unqueueing rest.
liam: reminder: throttling policy -> 10k tokens/sec global, but replay respects per-route SLO windows. monitor latency dashboards; if 95p latency > 500ms, pause job.
michael: I'll add an automated pause hook if trace errors spike >3x baseline.
sasha: good. alley-oop to ops if anything weird. final: job_id=bf-20260319-9c4 queued, dry-run started. keeping thread for updates.
